points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Structural validation passes original packages, but M0.8 inviscid metadata marks a force-unstable residual plateau converged; transient restart does not preserve history/time.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original eight packages and report pass structural validator; this does not establish stable force plateaus or physical accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reaches t=300 with actual target checks; M0.8 inviscid is incorrectly marked converged despite a moving lift tail and only 2.08/4 residual orders.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd≈2.019 is plausible; M0.8 inviscid lift varies strongly, M2 inviscid achieves 0.60 residual orders, M2 laminar Cd tail changes ~20%, and Re200 underpredicts St/amplitude.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted PDF shows all case histories/fields, including readable Re200 late lift/drag and wake. Curated source lacks some figure assets for complete reproduction.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses weak residual reductions and Re200 perturbation, but labels moving M0.8 lift steady and table calls final-window means final steady values.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF SHA and immutable TeX provenance verified; tools/analyze.py computes final-window means. Table caption mislabels them as final rows; full pixel-to-field audit not performed.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
